query: SELECT cm.id as moduleId, cm.title, COUNT(cl.id) as lesson_count, AVG(LENGTH(cl.content)) as avg_content_length, MIN(LENGTH(cl.content)) as min_content_length FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id WHERE cm.id IN (60001, 60002, 60003) GROUP BY cm.id, cm.title;
